newsitem.title: USA: US stocks seen up after price data.
newsitem.headline: US stocks seen up after price data.

text.p: U.S. stocks were seen opening higher on Thursday with bonds as August producer prices proved somewhat soothing and should give a short-term lift for Wall Street, analysts said.
Philip Orlando, Chief Investment Officer at Value Line Asset Management said:
"The core number was down and that was key. The fact that nominal was up 3/10 is somewhat problematic. It was probably energy-related."
